evals.name: atomic-event-write
evals.prompt: Save an updated order entity and emit an OrderCreated outbox event atomically.
evals.expected_output: A single database transaction writing the order record and inserting into the outbox table.
assertions: Order insert and outbox event insert execute within the same database transaction.
If either insert fails, the entire transaction rolls back.
Outbox record includes event payload, aggregate_id, event_type, and status='pending'.

evals.name: outbox-relay-worker
evals.prompt: Implement a background relay worker that polls pending outbox events and publishes them to Kafka.
evals.expected_output: Poller query using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, batch publishing, and marking published.
assertions: Uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED to allow multiple concurrent pollers.
Publishes event batch to message broker.
Updates outbox status to 'published' (or deletes) only after broker ack.

evals.name: idempotent-outbox-publishing
evals.prompt: A network error occurs after publishing an outbox event to Kafka but before updating the outbox table status.
evals.expected_output: Explanation of at-least-once delivery guarantee and downstream consumer deduplication.
assertions: Recognizes that outbox pattern guarantees at-least-once delivery.
Retries publishing on relay failure without dropping events.
Ensures event payloads carry unique event_id for downstream consumer deduplication.
